caption: A long jumper demonstrates a flawed technique, resulting in a short distance and an unbalanced landing.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Jumper airborne with arms extended, legs asymmetrically positioned; landing zone unmarked, distance unmeasured; no visible ground contact or post-landing stance.

INTERACTION: Takeoff momentum → airborne posture → landing impact → stance stabilization; unbalanced mid-air posture → asymmetric landing → instability propagation.

PERSISTENCE: Airborne phase sustains until foot contact; imbalance propagates through landing mechanics; instability persists if center of mass not recentered within 0.5s post-impact.

INTERVENTION: If takeoff lean is absent → reduced horizontal velocity → shorter jump; if landing feet are staggered → instability increases → recovery motion delayed; if no post-landing recentering → fall risk remains active.
